instruction: A pumpkin farm in late October: sprawling vines with pumpkins of every size, a lopsided scarecrow with a straw hat, a red barn with open doors and hay inside, dry corn rows rustling, a wooden wagon loaded with pumpkins, crows on a fence, bare oaks, a farmhouse porch with a jack-o'-lantern, and a huge harvest moon rising.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene: Pumpkin Patch Farm. A pumpkin farm in late October: sprawling vines with pumpkins of every size, a lopsided scarecrow with a straw hat, a red barn with open doors and hay inside, dry corn rows rustling, a wooden wagon loaded with pumpkins, crows on a fence, bare oaks, a farmhouse porch with a jack-o'-lantern, and a huge harvest moon rising. Style: autumn harvest warm. Entirely procedural geometry and textures (no external assets; canvas-generated textures are allowed). Compose a full environment — ground/backdrop plus several distinct focal structures and rich supporting props — with style-appropriate materials, a deliberate lighting rig with shadows, atmospheric depth (fog or a gradient sky where fitting), and subtle looping animation on at least three elements. Include OrbitControls with gentle auto-rotate, ACES filmic tone mapping, and a seeded PRNG so the layout is reproducible. Target roughly 600-700 lines of well-organized code.
